_about: GET https://api.skkuverse.com/bus/config, /bus/config/<groupId> for every group, /ui/home/transit and /ui/home/transitlist with Accept-Language ko, en and zh, and /bus/realtime/data/jongro02, jongro07 and jongro08 in ko, captured from production on 2026-10-20 between 00:08:42 and 00:08:53 UTC (09:08 KST), source commit d856f333. Every capture was 200. Each /bus/config/<groupId> body equaled that group in /bus/config's groups, so only its ETag is kept. The /bus/config ETags are the origin's strong ones: Cloudflare sent each as W/ plus the same quoted md5 because it compressed the body; the transit ETags are Express's own weak ones, as sent. Vary is the origin's, without the accept-encoding Cloudflare adds; /ui/home/transitlist sent no Cache-Control. Realtime depends on the buses running then, so only its group id and stations version are kept. Nothing else trimmed.
